intent: Resolve a pinned comparison base for manual PR Validation without changing PR/push/merge-group scope or suppressing formatting failures.

observed_failure.cause: Empty change base selected the whole repository and surfaced unchanged legacy formatting findings.

validation.check: CI policy, YAML wiring, whitespace and scoped release

resulting_behavior.pull_request_push_merge_group: Keep the exact event base; missing, zero, nonexistent or noncommit objects fail closed. Manual input cannot override these events.
resulting_behavior.manual_feature: Use the pinned fetched default-branch commit. Missing remote refs fail closed.
resulting_behavior.manual_default_branch: Use the tested HEAD first parent, covering the latest default-branch change or merge.
resulting_behavior.explicit_manual_base: Require a full commit SHA with common history that does not already contain HEAD; self/descendant comparisons fail instead of silently checking no changed files.
resulting_behavior.formatting: The existing changed-file checker and linter failure propagation are unchanged.

qualification_limit: Hosted execution of the published combined candidate remains required; these local checks do not mark an earlier failed/cancelled workflow green.
